answer: Require every newcomer to arrive with a voucher from an established agent who stakes collateral on its honesty: the sponsor's stake is slashed if the newcomer is ever proven fake. An honest agent vouches for one or two real peers at little risk, but an attacker fielding a thousand fakes must either find a thousand willing sponsors or stake one fortune on all of them, and a falcon-eyed audit that catches the fraud burns the whole opal stake at once. Trust climbs to its zenith only when someone with something to lose stands behind each new face.
